source.book: 剑桥KET标准版官方真题2（A2 Key 2，扫描版）

parts.1:
Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment before we start the test. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 1
One. What temperature will the woman use to cook the cake?
Woman: I'm going to put the cake in the cooker now. The temperature's at one hundred and forty degrees. Is that enough?
Man: That's a bit low. I think a hundred and eighty is better.
Woman: Why don't I put it in at a hundred and sixty because I think a hundred and eighty is too hot?
Man: All right. I hope it's good!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. What did Clara hurt when she played tennis?
Man: Hi, Clara, do you want to play tennis?
Woman: Sorry, I played yesterday, and I hurt myself, so I can't play today.
Man: Your foot again? You had problems with that last week as well.
Woman: No, I hit my leg with my racket when I was playing. My arms are stronger than I think!
Man: I hope you feel better soon.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Which photo did the man take?
Woman: These photos are great.
Man: Thanks. But they're not all mine. Just the one of the flowers. I'm choosing one to put on the wall in my new apartment. I like the boat picture best.
Woman: Oh, I prefer the one of the birds.
Man: Yes, it's nice. I've tried to take photos of birds before, but I wasn't quick enough.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Which was the woman's favourite present?
Man: Wow, you got lots of birthday presents!
Woman: Yes, I'm lucky. Mum usually gets me a book because I love reading. But not this time because the one I really like isn't available yet.
Man: OK, but that jumper looks nice.
Woman: It is, but I'm not sure about the colour. Anyway, this bag from my sister's the perfect size. Just what I wanted.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What did Tom lose?
Woman: Hi, Tom. You look sad.
Man: Yes, I can't find my mobile. I took it to Mark's party last night.
Man: I thought it was in my bag with my wallet when I left, but it wasn't.
Woman: Is this it? It was under my jacket when I was leaving. I thought it might be yours!
Man: Wow – thank you!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a phone message about going to play a hockey match.
Man: Hi, Sarah, it's Tom. I just wanted to give you some details about next week's hockey match against a new team called Tigers.
We usually play on Tuesday, but we're playing later in the week, on Friday. That's when everyone's available next week.
We're going to their village for the match. I don't think you've been there before, but it's a good place to play. The village is called Ledbury, that's spelled: L-E-D-B-U-R-Y. Write that down because it's not easy to get there, and you'll need to find it on a map. Sorry, but there's no bus that goes to the village, so you will need a car. We can go together.
Oh, can you pick up some drinks for the match? I've got all the equipment we need, and Sally's bringing fruit for after the match.
Please don't be late. Meeting at eight p.m. should give us enough time to practise before we start playing at eight forty-five. We'll be home before ten, tired, but happy we won, I hope! See you next week.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have twenty seconds.
You will hear Sue talking to her friend Peter about a restaurant she went to.
Sue: It's a pity you couldn't come to the restaurant with us last night, Peter.
Peter: Yeah, I wanted to come, Sue, but I wasn't well last week, and I forgot I needed to finish some work. How was the restaurant?
Sue: Great! I'd like to go there more often. The last time I went there was two years ago. The waiter said it's been open for five years already, and it's so popular that they had to open a new room a year ago.
Peter: Oh! What did you eat?
Sue: The restaurant's famous for pasta, but we all chose pizza, which was delicious. Maybe I'll get the steak next time – it looked good!
Peter: Isn't the chef from Italy?
Sue: Actually, he's from the USA. And our waiter was Spanish, so it's a very international place!
Peter: I have to go there! Come with me – I need you to tell me the best things on the menu. I've only got Wednesday night free next week, but I suppose it's quiet then, so I won't have to book a table.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a man and a woman talking about going shopping. What will they buy?
Man: Are you ready to go into town?
Woman: Yes, do you want to try on the coat that you saw last week?
Man: I'd rather go another day... I'd like to go to the bookshop. There's a book I want.
Woman: Great, I'll come with you to get the financial magazine I like. Shall we pick up a pizza for dinner?
Man: Hmmm... I'll cook instead.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a woman leaving a message for a friend. Why is the woman phoning her friend?
Woman: Hi, Stephanie! I was going to come round to your place this afternoon. I've got that book I agreed to lend you, but guess what? My car's not working, so I'll have to wait for it to be repaired this afternoon. I'm going to the theatre after dinner tonight, so we'll have to meet another time. I hope that's OK – sorry!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a man telling his sister about meeting someone yesterday. Who did he see in town?
Woman: Did you have fun in town?
Man: I only went for a newspaper, but do you remember Michael?
Woman: The man you live next door to?
Man: Not that Michael – the one who was in my class when I was a kid? We were best mates. He was in the shop and we had a good chat. He's got an amazing job as a pilot.
Woman: Cool!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear two friends making plans for the day. Where do they decide to go?
Woman: What a hot day for a picnic! Shall we go to the woods? It'll be cooler under the trees.
Man: Can't we go someplace where we can go swimming too?
Woman: Oh, but remember, I'm not a good swimmer. I don't feel safe in the river.
Man: How about the seaside? It's not dangerous there, and we can watch people sailing.
Woman: Oh, OK.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear a city tour guide giving a talk. Why is the museum closed now?
Man: This is the National Museum. I'm afraid we won't be able to go inside today, which is a pity because it's just been painted and looks lovely. You'll notice some roads are closed too – that's because an important visitor's arriving today – the Queen! She's here on holiday and is having a private tour of the museum, so we can't go in.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have fifteen seconds.
You will hear Susan talking to a friend about the sports she does. Which sport does she do with each person now?
Man: You do so many different sports, Susan, with so many different people! You and your cousin Elias play golf together, don't you?
Woman: Yes, we did last year, but now we play volleyball together.
Man: And with your neighbour, Daniel, you play tennis, don't you?
Woman: Daniel hurt his arm and can't play tennis any more, so we go fishing together instead.
Man: And your friend Amira? Does she like sport?
Woman: Yes, we've started going to the pool every week, but she's not sure she likes it. She'd like to join a badminton club soon.
Man: What about Kelly?
Woman: When she's not playing football, we go skateboarding in the park together.
Man: Do you do any sport with your brother, Ryan?
Woman: Yeah. He plays a lot of golf, and sometimes I go too. He's teaching me. Maybe in the future I'll teach him to be a better swimmer!
Man: You should! And I saw you going somewhere with Valerie yesterday. Were you carrying tennis rackets?
Woman: They were too small to be tennis rackets – you saw us with badminton rackets! We're having lessons at the sport centre. I love it!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 女士最初把温度设在 140 度（A 图），男士说 "That's a bit low. I think a hundred and eighty is better."；但女士觉得 180 度（C 图）太高："Why don't I put it in at a hundred and sixty because I think a hundred and eighty is too hot?"，男士同意（"All right. I hope it's good!"），所以最后用的是 160 度，选择 B。
explanations.p1q2: Clara 说 "I hit my leg with my racket when I was playing."，打球时球拍打到的是腿，选择 A。C 图（脚）只是男士的猜测 "Your foot again? You had problems with that last week as well."，那是上周的旧伤；B 图（手臂）来自她的玩笑 "My arms are stronger than I think!"，并不是受伤的部位。
explanations.p1q3: 男士说 "they're not all mine. Just the one of the flowers."，即这些照片里只有花的照片是他拍的，选择 B。A 图（小船）只是他最喜欢的一张 "I like the boat picture best."，但不是他拍的；C 图（鸟）也不是——"I've tried to take photos of birds before, but I wasn't quick enough."，说明他没能拍成鸟的照片。
explanations.p1q4: 女士说 "this bag from my sister's the perfect size. Just what I wanted."，姐姐送的包正是她想要的，选择 A。B 图（书）她没收到："the one I really like isn't available yet"；C 图（套衫）她拿不准颜色："I'm not sure about the colour"，都不是最想要的礼物。
explanations.p1q5: Tom 说 "I can't find my mobile."，丢的是手机，选择 C。A 图（钱包）不对，他说 "I thought it was in my bag with my wallet when I left, but it wasn't."，钱包好好地在他包里；B 图（夹克）也不对，女士说 "It was under my jacket when I was leaving."，手机只是掉在了她的夹克下面。
explanations.p2q1: Tom 说 "We usually play on Tuesday, but we're playing later in the week, on Friday. That's when everyone's available next week."，平时通常周二比赛，但下周改在周五打，因此填 Friday；Tuesday 是干扰信息。
explanations.p2q2: Tom 说 "The village is called Ledbury, that's spelled: L-E-D-B-U-R-Y."，比赛所在村子叫 Ledbury，并逐字母拼读，因此填 Ledbury；注意拼写要完全正确。
explanations.p2q3: Tom 说 "there's no bus that goes to the village, so you will need a car."，没有公交到那个村子，需要开车，因此填 car；bus 是被否定的干扰信息。
explanations.p2q4: Tom 问 "can you pick up some drinks for the match?"，请 Sarah 带饮料，因此填 drinks；装备他自己已备齐（"I've got all the equipment we need"），水果由 Sally 负责（"Sally's bringing fruit for after the match"），都不用 Sarah 带。
explanations.p2q5: Tom 说 "we start playing at eight forty-five"，比赛 8 点 45 分开始，因此填 8.45（晚间即 20.45）；"Meeting at eight p.m." 是集合时间，"We'll be home before ten" 的 10 点是预计到家时间，都不是比赛开始时间。
explanations.p3q1: Peter 说 "I wanted to come, Sue, but I wasn't well last week, and I forgot I needed to finish some work."，他忘了要完成一些工作，所以昨晚没去成，选择 A。B（病得太重）不对——"I wasn't well last week" 说的是上周，不是昨晚；C（忘记去聚餐）不对——他忘记的是工作，不是聚餐本身。
explanations.p3q2: Sue 转述 "The waiter said it's been open for five years already"，餐厅已开业五年，选择 C。"The last time I went there was two years ago" 是她上次去的时间，"they had to open a new room a year ago" 是一年前增开新厅，都不是开业时长。
explanations.p3q3: Sue 说 "The restaurant's famous for pasta, but we all chose pizza, which was delicious."，他们点的是披萨，选择 B。pasta 只是这家餐厅的招牌菜（不是他们那天吃的）；牛排是她 "Maybe I'll get the steak next time" 下次才想点的。
explanations.p3q4: Peter 猜 "Isn't the chef from Italy?"，Sue 纠正 "Actually, he's from the USA."，厨师是美国人，选择 A。西班牙语的是他们的服务员（"our waiter was Spanish"），意大利只是 Peter 的错误猜测。
explanations.p3q5: Peter 说 "Come with me – I need you to tell me the best things on the menu."，要 Sue 告诉他菜单上最好的菜，即希望她给菜品建议，选择 C。A 不对——他 "I've only got Wednesday night free next week"，只有周三晚上有空，并非哪天去都行；B 不对——他觉得那天 "it's quiet then"，不会太挤。
explanations.p4q1: 男士说 "There's a book I want"，女士也要买 "the financial magazine I like"，书和杂志都是读物，选择 C。A（吃的）不成立——男士拒绝了买披萨的提议（"Hmmm... I'll cook instead."）；B（穿的）不成立——外套只是女士问男士要不要试穿（"do you want to try on the coat"），男士宁愿改天再去。
explanations.p4q2: 女士本来说 "I was going to come round to your place this afternoon"，但 "My car's not working"，而且晚上要去剧院，只好 "we'll have to meet another time"，打电话是为了改约，选择 A。借书只是顺带一提 "I've got that book I agreed to lend you"（是她借书给朋友，不是借入）；她也没有请朋友吃饭。
explanations.p4q3: 女士先猜是邻居 "The man you live next door to?"，男士否认 "Not that Michael"，他见到的是 "the one who was in my class when I was a kid? We were best mates."，儿时同班、曾经最要好的朋友，选择 C（an old school friend）；A（同事）对话完全没有提到。
explanations.p4q4: 女士先提议去树林（"Shall we go to the woods?"），男士想去能游泳的地方，最后男士说 "How about the seaside? It's not dangerous there"，女士答应 "Oh, OK."，决定去海边，选择 C。树林（A）被放弃；河（B）被女士否定（"I don't feel safe in the river"）。
explanations.p4q5: 导游说 "an important visitor's arriving today – the Queen! She's here on holiday and is having a private tour of the museum, so we can't go in."，重要贵宾到访、进行私人参观导致闭馆，选择 A。B 不对——女王是 "here on holiday"，并非今天是全国假日；C 不对——博物馆 "it's just been painted and looks lovely"，刚粉刷完，不是正在粉刷。
explanations.p5q1: Susan 说 "Daniel hurt his arm and can't play tennis any more, so we go fishing together instead."，现在和 Daniel 一起钓鱼，选择 B（fishing）；tennis 是 Daniel 手臂受伤前打的球，现在不打了。
explanations.p5q2: Susan 说 "we've started going to the pool every week"，每周和 Amira 去泳池游泳，选择 F（swimming）；badminton 只是 Amira 想加入的俱乐部（"She'd like to join a badminton club soon"），还没开始打。
explanations.p5q3: Susan 说 "When she's not playing football, we go skateboarding in the park together."，和 Kelly 一起在公园玩滑板，选择 E（skateboarding）；football 是 Kelly 自己玩的运动，不是她们俩一起做的。
explanations.p5q4: Susan 说 "He plays a lot of golf, and sometimes I go too."，哥哥 Ryan 常打高尔夫，她有时也去，选择 D（golf）；swimming 是她将来想教 Ryan 的（"I'll teach him to be a better swimmer!"），不是现在一起做的运动。
explanations.p5q5: 男士问 "Were you carrying tennis rackets?"，Susan 解释 "They were too small to be tennis rackets – you saw us with badminton rackets!"，她拿的是羽毛球拍，选择 A（badminton）；tennis rackets 只是男士的误会。

uncertain: p1q1: 扫描页分辨率较低，sixty/eighty 易混淆；Woman 第二句已与本书官方精讲页（printed 96，PDF 097）核对确认为 "Why don't I put it in at a hundred and sixty because I think a hundred and eighty is too hot?"。
p1q5: 扫描页上说话人标签较小；Man/Woman 标注已与本书官方精讲页（printed 97，PDF 098）交叉核对（男士说 "I can't find my mobile" 与 "I thought it was in my bag..."，女士说 "It was under my jacket..."）后确定。
